description: React component for displaying post pre-header with pinned/flagged status and navigation links in Mattermost.

classes.name: PostPreHeader
classes.description: React component rendering post pre-header with pinned/flagged status and navigation links.

methods.name: getPostStatus
methods.description: Determines if a post is flagged, pinned, both, or neither based on props.

methods.name: getMessageInfo
methods.description: Decides which message key to display based on post status and skip flags.

methods.name: handleLinkClick
methods.description: Handles click events on links to show pinned or flagged posts.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the component UI based on post status and flags.
